<groupId>org.openapitools</groupId>
                <artifactId>openapi-generator-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <!-- RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <version>${maven.openapi-generator-plugin.version}</version>
                <!-- /RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>generate</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <inputSpec>${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/openapi.yml</inputSpec>
                            <generatorName>spring</generatorName>
                            <library>spring-boot</library>

                            <!-- Only enabling model andopenapi-generator-maven-plugin API generation -->
                            <modelNameSuffix>Dto</modelNameSuffix>
                            <apiPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.api</apiPackage>
                            <generateModels>true</generateModels>
                            <modelPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto</modelPackage>
                            <generateApis>true</generateApis>
                            <importMappings>
                                <importMapping>Nullable=org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable</importMapping>
                            </importMappings>
                            <configOptions>
                                <!-- RestController implementation is provided by Petclinic developers -->
                                <interfaceOnly>true</interfaceOnly>
                                <!-- Generate API interfaces from OpenAPI tags -->
                                <useTags>true</useTags>
                                <!-- Activating Java 8 features -->
                                <performBeanValidation>true</performBeanValidation>
                                <useSpringBoot3>true</useSpringBoot3>
                                <useJakartaEe>true</useJakartaEe>
                                <openApiNullable>false</openApiNullable>
                                <!-- override the default library to jersey2 -->
                                <serializationLibrary>jackson</serializationLibrary>
                                <!-- switch documentation provider to springdoc -->
                                <documentationProvider>springdoc</documentationProvider>
                            </configOptions>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
                <artifactId>build-helper-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>add-source</id>
                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>add-source</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <sources>
                                <source>target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java</source>
                            </sources>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>

All tests pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`). The suite's 3 acceptance tests — missing-field, blank-field, and complete-owner — are green.

## Summary

I implemented owner-creation validation for the `POST /api/owners` endpoint so that an owner missing or blank in any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone` is rejected with **400** and a JSON body whose `errors` array lists each offending field name.

The endpoint uses an OpenAPI-generated interface with `@Valid` bean validation, which created two paths to a 400 that I unified:

1. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — added `rejectMissingOrBlankFields(...)`, which checks all five fields for `null` or blank (whitespace-only) and throws a new `InvalidOwnerFieldsException` carrying the field names. This catches the whitespace-blank `city`/`address` cases that the generated `@Size(min=1)`/`@NotNull` constraints let through.

2. **`InvalidOwnerFieldsException`** (new, in `rest.advice`) — carries the list of offending field names.

3. **`ExceptionControllerAdvice`** — 
   - Added a handler for `InvalidOwnerFieldsException` → 400 with `errors` set to the field names.
   - Enhanced the existing `MethodArgumentNotValidException` handler (which fires for genuinely missing/null fields and pattern violations caught by `@Valid` before the controller body runs) to also populate an `errors` array of the distinct invalid field names.

Both paths now emit a consistent `errors` array, so every "missing or blank" case across all five fields returns 400 with the field name(s), matching the specification. Changes follow the existing `ProblemDetail`-based advice conventions in the repo.

Note: this isn't a git repository, so I made no commits — let me know if you'd like anything adjusted.
